name: Ise Haruka
source:
Haruka is [url=/c1501]Kouhei’s[/url] childhood friend, she’s mostly energetic and gets on well with everyone, however, she can be a little tsun towards Kouhei sometimes. She’s also quite good at cooking and likes gardening.

[From [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/08/12/relations-sister-x-sister-review/]Liemyx's review[/url].]
